title: Standing trading authorization: arming a strategy is the owner's standing click
lifecycle_note: Merged 2026-11-17 by the owner's click; amendments 1-2 on 11-17, 3-5 on 11-18, 6 on 11-19, 7-9 on 11-20, 10 (risk bounds per profile) on 11-21. No platform build but doctrine bounds; xauusd's RFC_STRATEGY_RECOMMENDATION and later RFCs implement it.

phases.title: The decision recorded; the vision core's trading line amended

evidence.quote: given per action or as a standing arm of one strategy

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: this ADR changes no platform code

phases.title: Amendment 1 recorded: AUTO under Omega's live arm when nothing is armed; the Position Manager only reduces risk

of.quote: as Omega's live arm for AUTO selection of the single best strategy

phases.note: proven once a strategy_arm.v1 report shows mode auto (AUTO running with nothing armed); until then, the documented decision

phases.title: Amendment 2 recorded: while the owner's Council auto-arm is on, the council arms and disarms within its gates

evidence.quote: while the owner's Council auto-arm is on, by the council within its gates

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build

phases.title: Amendment 3 recorded: an autonomous profile upgrade only up to the owner's ceiling, never mid-trade

evidence.quote: The highest profile the agent may reach is set only by the owner

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: xauusd builds the profiles and the profile agent

phases.title: Amendment 4 recorded: the Position Manager's TP ladder and partial closes, only once the stop locks a profit

evidence.quote: but only while its stop loss already locks a profit

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: xauusd builds the ladder and the partial closes

phases.title: Amendment 5 recorded: a council veto on soft-trigger downgrades only; kill switch and daily loss never vetoed

evidence.quote: A council failure, an invalid verdict or a timeout means the downgrade applies.

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: xauusd builds it behind a flag, off until merged

phases.title: Amendment 6 recorded: TP2 before the TP1 lock only in one modification with the stop at break-even plus the spread

evidence.quote: a broker that refuses the stop leaves both unchanged

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: xauusd builds it after this amendment is merged

phases.title: Amendment 7 recorded: resting limit entries under the arm, moved only toward price and cancelled on any disarm

evidence.quote: A resting entry counts as an open position for the cap of 3 armed strategies

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: xauusd keeps LIMIT_ENTRY_AVAILABLE false until it is merged

phases.title: Amendment 8 recorded: one council loosening of an open position's stop, never beyond the original entry stop

evidence.quote: Never beyond the position's original entry stop, so its money at risk stays at most the 1R sized at entry.

phases.note: a decision, not a build; switch off by default. Owner 11-20 ("2 ya"): brokerKeyLevels with source liquidity are key levels for A8's measured reason

phases.title: Amendment 9 recorded: WAIT-with-bias entries past the quorum share only; the veto and every other guardrail kept

evidence.quote: Every guardrail of that side except the quorum share. A Decision Engine veto still blocks it.

phases.note: a documented decision, not a build: xauusd enters live only behind wait_bias_entry, off by default, after it is merged

phases.title: Amendment 10 recorded: Omega's risk bounds follow the account profile, the engine setting only tightens

evidence.quote: A setting can only tighten inside a profile, never widen it.

phases.note: a decision and its doctrine bounds (omega.*_<profile>); xauusd already enforces the table; Aether mirrors the bounds

phases.title: Arm and disarm in Nexus: cap of 3, auto-disarm, Decision Engine veto
phases.note: proven by a strategy_arm.v1 report that mirrors an owner's arm or disarm click in Nexus

phases.title: Arm and disarm mirrored as strategy_arm.v1 xauusd_digest reports
phases.note: proven by any strategy_arm.v1 report of xauusd-risk-manager in agent_reports
